# 0x25C — `imu_unknown`

DLC 4 · 100 Hz · status: **unknown**

Not decoded. B0 takes many values (16 seen) and B1 about a dozen (0x11-0x1C). The low nibbles of B2 and B3 are always 0xB while the high nibbles vary. No correlation with lean, yaw or roll above 0.24.

## Layout

Bytes are numbered from 0. Multi-byte values are big-endian unless a row says otherwise. Bit 7 is the most significant bit of a byte.

| Byte | Content |
|---|---|
| B0 | — |
| B1 | — |
| B2 | — |
